shared_elements: low relief carving in pale stone
bird in profile with prominent beak
human or humanoid figure in profile, crouching or seated
horizontal incised lines dividing the surface into registers/bands
a band of small repeated motifs running horizontally
figures rendered as flat raised silhouettes with little interior modelling
justification: Both surfaces are pale stone worked in shallow flat relief and divided by ruled horizontal lines into stacked registers, each containing profile creatures — birds with heavy beaks, quadrupeds and crouching human-like figures — plus a band of small repeated marks. The decisive difference is scale and density: A carries a handful of large, boldly isolated animals on an irregular, tapering pillar photographed in the ground, while B is a neat round-topped slab crowded with tiny, regularly spaced sign-like elements arranged in columns beside larger seated figures, implying a script-like system absent from A.
